Name: COG
Description: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF standard/layout enabling HTTP range requests and partial reads.

Name: COPC
Description: Cloud Optimized Point Cloud format enabling range-readable access to point clouds.

Name: dask
Description: Parallel and distributed computing framework for scaling Python analytics; commonly paired with Xarray for EO workloads.

Name: Planetary Explorer (formerly Earth Co-pilot)
Description: MIT-licensed reference application for natural-language discovery and visualization of geospatial data using Planetary Computer and Azure AI services; assess cloud dependencies and operating costs.

Name: Earth on AWS
Description: Program and registry for discovering open geospatial datasets hosted on AWS.

Name: gdal
Description: Foundational geospatial I/O and processing library for raster and vector formats; underpins many EO and GIS tools.
Tags: ["Core Library", "Data management", "Geocoding and georeferencing", "Remote sensing analysis"]

Name: Geospatial Foundation Models & Vision Transformers
Description: Large pretrained EO/remote-sensing models (often ViT-based) that learn transferable representations for multiple EO tasks.

Name: GeoZarr
Description: Geospatial conventions for storing multidimensional georeferenced grids using Zarr; defines metadata patterns for EO data cubes.

Name: hdf5
Description: Scientific data model and file format for storing large array-based datasets; common in EO archives.

Name: Hyperspectral
Description: EO data modality with many contiguous spectral bands enabling material/biophysical inference beyond multispectral imagery.

Name: Lidar
Description: Laser based active remote sensing producing 3D point clouds used for terrain, canopy, and infrastructure modeling.

Name: Prithvi-EO-2.0
Description: Multi-temporal EO foundation model pretrained on 30 m Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel optical imagery, with released weights and TerraTorch-based downstream fine-tuning examples.

Name: TESSERA
Description: Foundation model generating pixel embeddings from satellite time series.

Name: Major TOM
Description: Tools for filtering EO datasets and generating embeddings.

Name: Clay
Description: Foundation model generating embeddings from satellite imagery.

Name: netcdf
Description: Self-describing scientific data format and libraries for array-oriented geoscience data; common for EO/climate gridded products.

Name: NISAR data
Description: NASA-ISRO SAR data for surface change, ecosystems and cryosphere applications. L-band covers global land and ice; S-band covers India and selected sites. Check product validation and access conditions.

Name: openEO
Description: Open API specification for EO processing across interoperable backends.

Name: Pangeo
Description: Community and ecosystem enabling open, reproducible, scalable geoscience and EO analysis (often using Xarray/Dask/Zarr).

Name: pdal
Description: Point cloud processing and translation library with pipeline-based filters; core for LiDAR and 3D workflows.
Comment: probably more lidar/gis rather than EO

Name: Planetary Computer
Description: Open-access geospatial data catalogued with STAC and served via STAC API and tiling.

Name: Satpy
Description: Python library for reading, processing and writing data from Earth-observing satellite instruments.

Name: OSGeo/PROJ
Description: Coordinate reference system and cartographic projections library used across geospatial stacks.

Name: OGC OSPD Workflows
Description: Experimental workflow metadata and provenance schemas from OGC's Open Science Persistent Demonstrator for describing and reusing Earth science workflows across platforms.

Name: Raster Vision
Description: Framework for training CV models on satellite/aerial imagery (detection, segmentation).

Name: stac
Description: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog specification for describing and discovering geospatial/EO assets via interoperable JSON metadata.

Name: STAC GeoParquet
Description: Specification for storing STAC Items in GeoParquet for efficient bulk access and catalog queries.

Name: titiler
Description: FastAPI-based dynamic tile server toolkit for serving EO rasters (COGs, STAC items, mosaics) as map tiles.

Name: geotiff.js
Description: JavaScript library for reading GeoTIFF raster data and metadata in browsers and Node.js.

Name: deck.gl-raster
Description: GPU-accelerated GeoTIFF and Zarr visualization in deck.gl directly in the browser.

Name: torchgeo
Description: PyTorch domain library providing geospatial/remote-sensing datasets, samplers, transforms, and pretrained models.

Name: VirtualiZarr
Description: Creates 'virtual' Zarr datasets over archival formats (e.g., netCDF/HDF), enabling cloud-friendly access without copying data.

Name: Xarray
Description: Labelled N-dimensional arrays/datasets for gridded EO and climate data cubes and spatiotemporal analysis.

Name: xdggs
Description: Xarray extension for working with data indexed by Discrete Global Grid Systems (DGGS).

Name: Zarr
Description: Open specification and ecosystem for chunked N-dimensional arrays, enabling scalable cloud/object-storage workflows.

Name: QGIS
Description: General-purpose desktop geographic information system.

Name: CF Conventions
Description: Metadata conventions describing physical quantities, coordinates, cells and calendars in scientific datasets; complements netCDF and Zarr.

Name: SNAP
Description: ESA platform and toolboxes for processing supported Earth observation products, including optical and SAR workflows.

Name: odc-stac
Description: Loads STAC raster assets into georeferenced Xarray datasets, with output-grid control and optional Dask-backed loading.

Name: TerraTorch
Description: PyTorch toolkit for fine-tuning and applying Earth observation model backbones to segmentation, classification and regression tasks.

Name: WeatherBench-X
Description: Framework for evaluating weather forecasts against gridded references or sparse observations, with configurable metrics, weighting and aggregation.

Name: RO-Crate with Workflow Run profiles
Description: RO-Crate profiles for packaging workflow execution provenance and relationships between inputs, outputs, software and activities; replay and data integrity require separate checks.

Name: OGC Building Blocks
Description: Reusable specification components, schemas and validation tools for geospatial APIs, metadata and Earth observation workflow descriptions.

Name: NASA Worldview
Description: NASA web application for exploring global satellite imagery through time using GIBS, including near-real-time layers and polar views.

Name: Copernicus Browser
Description: Web application for finding, viewing and comparing Copernicus satellite imagery, with band combinations, timelapses and product downloads.

Name: eodash
Description: Configurable web dashboard framework for visualizing Earth observation datasets and indicators with maps, charts and linked time controls.

Name: geemap
Description: Python package for interactive satellite imagery maps, comparisons and time-series visualization with Google Earth Engine in notebooks.

Name: NASA CMR
Description: NASA Earthdata's metadata catalog for discovering Earth science collections and granules through search and STAC APIs.

Name: Earth Search
Description: Element 84's public STAC catalog of satellite imagery and other geospatial datasets on AWS, including Sentinel and Landsat collections.

Name: Earth Engine Data Catalog
Description: Google's catalog of public satellite imagery and environmental datasets available in Earth Engine, with STAC metadata maintained on GitHub.

Name: EOxElements
Description: Reusable web components for EO maps, layer controls, STAC metadata, charts and time navigation.

Name: rio-tiler
Description: Python library for reading COG and STAC raster assets into map tiles and previews, with rescaling, color maps and band expressions.

Name: GeoRasterLayer for Leaflet
Description: Reusable Leaflet layer for rendering GeoTIFF and COG imagery with custom color functions and reprojection support.

Name: MapLibre COG Protocol
Description: JavaScript plugin for rendering EPSG:3857 COG imagery directly in MapLibre GL JS, with color ramps and satellite band combinations.

Name: EarthCODE Open Science Catalog
Description: ESA's STAC catalog of Earth science datasets, projects, workflows and experiments, with links to data, code and documentation.

Name: OpenLayers
Description: Reusable JavaScript mapping library for displaying satellite imagery, COGs, vector overlays and OGC map services in web applications.

Name: dask-array
Description: Dask's chunked array module for parallel NumPy-style processing of EO data larger than memory.

Name: Cubed
Description: Python library for scalable array processing with bounded memory and Zarr storage.

Name: Portolan
Description: Open specification for publishing geospatial catalogs on object storage using STAC metadata and cloud-optimized formats such as COG, GeoParquet and PMTiles.

Name: rioxarray
Description: Rasterio-powered Xarray extension for reading, writing, clipping and reprojecting georeferenced rasters.

Name: kerchunk
Description: Creates references to chunks in existing NetCDF, HDF5, GRIB and TIFF files for virtual Zarr access and aggregation without copying source data.

Name: PhilEO Bench
Description: Evaluation framework for EO foundation models using Sentinel-2 imagery for land cover classification, road segmentation and building density estimation.

Name: healpix-geo
Description: Coordinate and indexing library for Earth observation data on HEALPix grids with WGS84 ellipsoid support.

Name: healpix-resample
Description: Python library for regridding longitude/latitude samples onto HEALPix grids using reusable PyTorch sparse operators on CPU or GPU.

Name: healpix-analyse
Description: Differentiable PyTorch toolkit for HEALPix signal analysis, including spherical harmonics, power spectra, convolutions and multiresolution operations.

Name: healpix-plot
Description: Python library for plotting HEALPix Earth data with Matplotlib and Cartopy using WGS84 ellipsoid-aware coordinate conversions.

Name: Gridlook
Description: Browser-based WebGL viewer for Earth-system and EO datasets in Zarr and Icechunk, with support for local NetCDF files.

Name: Xarray-Spatial
Description: Raster analysis for Xarray, including multispectral indices, terrain analysis and zonal statistics.

Name: MetPy
Description: Python tools for meteorological analysis, including satellite-data readers, atmospheric calculations and visualization.

Name: cf-xarray
Description: Xarray accessor for selecting and interpreting data using CF metadata rather than dataset-specific variable names.

Name: xbatcher
Description: Generates batches and sliding-window patches from Xarray datasets for machine-learning training and inference on EO imagery.

Name: hvPlot
Description: High-level plotting library for Xarray and other Python data structures, including interactive satellite RGB images and geographic raster maps.
